- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for a bedtime routine include: 
  1. Set a consistent sleep schedule.
  2. Gradually adjust bedtime by 15-30 minutes.
  3. Create a relaxing bedtime routine (reading, warm bath, meditation, etc.).
  4. Make the sleep environment comfortable (dark, quiet, cool, clutter-free).
  5. Limit screen time before bed (at least an hour).
  6. Avoid stimulating activities before bed (exercise, video games).
  7. Get morning sunlight.
  8. Avoid caffeine and heavy meals before bed (4-6 hours).
  9. Wear comfortable sleepwear.
  10. Make mornings enjoyable with a positive routine.
